# Powrush

> Powrush is a game from Autonomicity Games Inc. Take everything and the glow fades. Share it, and the climate comes back. The current build is offline and single-player, and it’s in active development. Online play isn’t available yet. There’s no Steam page and no release date. It isn’t a public launch candidate. Powrush has been in the works since 2016 (https://acitygames.com/powrush.html). This site is https://powrush.com. The company site is https://acitygames.com.

## Pages

- Home: https://powrush.com/
- World: https://powrush.com/world.html
- Systems: https://powrush.com/systems.html
- Play: https://powrush.com/play.html

## Status

- Play on this site is coming later. Online play isn’t available yet.
- You and one machine. Offline first.
- The yard is the whole universe, shrunk to the size of a well. The wider story has five peoples and a stone.
- Walk a living climate. Harvest with mercy. Learn a resource-based economy by playing it. It’s a lesson, not a wage.
- Repository: https://github.com/Eternally-Thriving-Grandmasterism/Powrush-MMO
- From the studio behind Powrush: https://acitygames.com (Autonomicity Games Inc.) and https://rathor.ai

## Peoples & leaders

- World: a fractured Earth, with magma islands and a scarred moon.
- Quellorians: luminous ancient aliens whose lost homeworld had two suns. Led by High Luminar Solmaris Orynthe (sol-MAR-is). They belong to the Luminari Alliance (mothership TAUN), which opposes the Draek Dominion.
- Draeks: biomechanical aliens. The Draek Dominion is ruled by the Hivelord, whose true name is unknown. Freed Draeks follow Vrendak the Unbound (VREN-dak), who was once the Drainer and broke free.
- Humans: survivors caught between two cosmic powers. Led by Warden Ronan Ashcroft.
- Cydruids: druids who chose to become cyborgs, humans and machines merged as one. They live in an upside-down stalactite city deep in Earth’s hollows, always burrowing, and harvest with care. Led by Archdruid Orin Hollowell.
- Ambrosians: living crystal, tuned to harmony. Led by Lyrisse, Voice of the Prism Choir.
